name: Zotero Cite Links Enhanced
description: Ctrl-click or Cmd-click a Pandoc citation key to open the cited PDF in Zotero at the page printed in the source, or hover with Ctrl or Cmd held to see its bibliography entry. A plain click opens the source's own note in the vault at that page (no Zotero needed), Ctrl or Cmd hover can preview that note instead, and a command lists cited keys with no item in Zotero. A fork of Zotero Cite Links.
author: jpeacock29; fork by Gameboard-dev
